criteria.demonstration: The real retained TLV admits known-number/empty and advisory unknown bytes while rejecting malformed known forms and unsupported critical tags. The owned record narrows each payload to16 bytes, admits0..8 fields, rejects known duplicates and preserves every unknown occurrence. Whole admission through actual FCursor/f_take and retained ADT TLV parsing precedes publication.

criteria.demonstration: Stable tag ordering preserves equal-tag duplicate order and authenticates every occurrence with an exact versioned/domain-separated HMAC transcript. An original local projection defect admits tag9 duplicate edits and increments only a synthetic privileged counter; complete-transcript verification rejects the old code, and a separate whitelist refuses even freshly authenticated unknown semantics. Counter overflow leaves both fields unchanged. Signature transcript participation is specified without claiming asymmetric execution. The delayed ordering/version/policy variant, thirteen cost rows and repeated maximum-record measurements are supplied.

limits: Original local format, not Protobuf wire compatibility. HMAC execution is distinct from specified public-key signature transcript policy.
Synthetic local authorization violation is not arbitrary code execution, host privilege escalation or a cryptographic forgery.
No published C17/C23 inspection, independent learner result or non-author review inferred.
